method: Python standard library zipfile, pickletools, and a three-global allowlisted metadata-only Unpickler. Torch was not imported; tensor rebuilds returned inert metadata dictionaries. No native response arrays, test data, or candidate data were read.
scientific_disposition: NOT_PROMOTED. This checkpoint is a completed two-epoch original-development research probe with substantially worse field and weak-equilibrium errors than its original V2 reference. Constructed closure near zero does not establish accuracy improvement or complete adaptive J2 evolution.
